lines.text: Pizza or tacos? Fine by me.

data.define: Used to say you accept an idea.

example.text: Pizza or tacos? Fine by me.

misuse.text: Don't say 'fine by me' when you're upset.
misuse.why: People will think you truly don't mind.

data.l1_hook: Pizza atau taco, pilih saja. "fine by me".
data.l1_ex: Pizza atau taco? Fine by me.

native.tip: “fine by me” = saya sih oke. Contoh: “Pizza or tacos? Fine by me.”
native.caption:
Apa arti “fine by me”?
“fine by me” = saya sih oke.
Contoh: “Pizza or tacos? Fine by me.” (Pizza atau taco? Fine by me.)
